picks.headline: AWS Bedrock Expands OpenAI GPT-6 Access Across Asia-Pacific Regions
picks.why: Provides regional enterprise deployments low-latency access to GPT-6 Sol, Luna, and Astra variants on Bedrock.
picks.title: Accessing OpenAI GPT models on Amazon Bedrock with global cross-Region inference in Thailand, Malaysia, Singapore, Indonesia, and Taiwan

picks.headline: X-AgentRed Red-Teams Personal AI Agents Across Multi-Service Ecosystems
picks.why: Uses tool-dependency graphs and execution feedback to automatically discover complex indirect cross-service attack vectors in AI agents.
picks.title: X-AgentRed: Red-Teaming Personal Agents in Evolving Multi-Service Ecosystems

picks.headline: vLLM Enables Bi-Directional KV Transfer for Multi-Turn Agentic Workloads
picks.why: Prefill nodes can retrieve existing KV cache from decode nodes, eliminating redundant prefill recomputation in iterative agent interactions.
picks.title: Improve TTFT for Multi-Turn Agentic Workloads with Bi-Directional KV Transfer in vLLM

picks.headline: Meta Unveils OSPA Standard and Liquid-Cooled Fabrics for Gigawatt AI
picks.why: Establishes open network architectures and Ethernet scale-up specifications essential for emerging gigawatt-scale training clusters.
picks.title: OCP Summit 2026: Powering AI with Open Innovations in Scale-Up, Scale-Out, and Scale-Across Networks

picks.headline: Meta Harvests Idle Fleet Capacity to Run Opportunistic Recommendation Workloads
picks.why: Significantly boosts GPU utilization by dynamically routing non-critical inference across heterogeneous idle hardware without additional capital expenditure.
picks.title: Turning Opportunistic AI Inference Capacity Into Better Ads Recommendations

picks.headline: AWS Releases Ray LLM DLCs for Disaggregated Multi-Node Inference
picks.why: Simplifies deploying production disaggregated prefill and decode LLM serving infrastructure on Amazon EKS.
picks.title: Run multi-node inference workloads using Ray LLM Deep Learning Containers

papers.headline: Elastic Latent Recurrence Enables Test-Time Compute Scaling via Latent Loops
papers.why: Trains latent recurrent models that match standard transformer efficiency in a single loop while dynamically gaining accuracy when unrolled further at inference time.
papers.title: One Model to Loop Them All: Elastic Latent Recurrence for Language Models

papers.headline: LLMs Exhibit Thinking Inertia, Persistent Inference Despite No-Thinking Prompts
papers.why: Reveals that prompt-level controls attempting to disable chain-of-thought reasoning fail as target response spaces become open-ended.
papers.title: Thinking Inertia: LLMs Keep Thinking When Told Not To

papers.headline: ReplaySSM Caches Inputs Instead of Hidden States to Speed Decoding
papers.why: Replaces memory-bandwidth-heavy state reads and writes with periodic checkpoint unrolling to streamline state-space model inference.
papers.title: ReplaySSM: Cache SSM Inputs, Not State
